messages:
suzanne: Quick sync — we need a concise POC wrap for Orion Retail tomorrow. Customer wants a 15m exec readout + 30m tech deep dive. Can we confirm final metrics, open security/pricing blockers, and a clear next-steps slide?

omar: I can pull the metric snapshot and the eval corpus. Do we want raw numbers + relative targets (e.g., success = p95 < 400ms, hallucination < 3%) or the absolute numbers only? :clipboard:

vijay: Execs want 3 things: business outcome (recs moved to cart %), cost delta vs current infra, and timeline to prod. Technical audience wants latency/throughput and failure modes. Keep the exec slide single-panel w/traffic light status.

mike: From logs (last 48h):
```
avg_latency_p95: 432ms
avg_tokens_per_req: 680
error_rate: 0.8% (mostly 429s during 11:00-11:20 window)
generation_cost_per_1k_tokens_est: $0.42
hallucination_rate_on_eval_suite_v3: 4.1% (n=1200 prompts)
throughput_peak: 180 r/s
```
Notes: the p95 is driven by long-context chat sessions — KV cache hit rate is ~56%. We can push p95 < 380ms by enabling prefix caching + increasing batch thresholds.

claire: Security checklist status for Orion Retail: SOC2 report shared (done), data residency confirmed (US-EAST), KMS integration pending (customer asks for HSM-backed key proof), SSO OIDC config in progress. I need to get signed NDA addendum and their DPA to return final sign-off.

omar: For the readout deck I propose 1 slide each: Summary, Business metrics, Model/eval results (include sample failure cases), Reliability & cost, Security/compliance status, Recommendations & next steps. I can draft slides and include the eval snippets. Need someone to own the failure-case writeup.

vijay: I can own the business metrics slide and the ask for committed capacity/pricing options. For pricing: customer asked about 10% discount on committed Dedicated for 12 months + option to burst. We need numbers by EOD to include in readout.

mike: Quick technical add — hallucination measurement uses a bechmark of label-based exact match + semantic similarity. We saw 60% of hallucinations were truncated references to old catalogs. Short-term mitigation: clamp context to 1024 for catalog queries, and add a reranker filter on entity validity.

suzanne: Thanks. Can each person drop the deliverable + ETA here? I'll assemble deck. Also any ask to bring someone from infra or account exec to the readout?

omar: deliverable: draft tech slides + eval artifacts. ETA: 4pm today. Need review by Mike.

vijay: deliverable: pricing options with committed tier math + expansion model. ETA: 3:30pm. Will include 12mo committed vs pay-as-you-go table.

mike: deliverable: annotated failure cases (3) + suggested mitigations + quantitative impact estimate if we enable prefix caching. ETA: 2:30pm.

claire: deliverable: security slide + outstanding items list + wording for DPA addendum. ETA: 5pm (waiting on legal). Need Orion security contact to confirm HSM requirement.

deploy-bot: deploy notice — staging:2026-01-15T11:02:14Z applied config: "prefix-caching=true, kv-size=48mb"

suzanne: Great. Action items for readout:
- Omar: draft tech slides (4pm)
- Mike: failure cases + mitigation (2:30pm)
- Vijay: pricing + committed offer (3:30pm)
- Claire: security sign-off status + DPA wording (5pm)
- Me: assemble deck, run rehearsal at 09:30 tomorrow.

One more: customer asked for a short appendix with sample prompts and eval rubric. Omar/mike, can you add the prompt set (top 20) and the eval scoring method into the appendix?

omar: Yup — will include prompt_set_v3 (top20) and eval_rubric.md content inline.

mike: I'll attach sample failing prompts + before/after mitigation examples.

vijay: FYI, if Orion buys Dedicated we should model 20% reduction in per-token cost after 3 months of sustained usage (conservative). I'll add that to the expansion slide.

suzanne: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, ping me directly. I'll pull together the rehearsal calendar invite once the deck is near-final. :rocket:
